result.instructions: Tools for Rechnio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how much is open in total?"; "Create a draft invoice for Musterfirma GmbH: 20 hours web development at 95 EUR."; "Show the bank transactions from last quarter in the category Einnahmen.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rechnio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rechnio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rechnio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rechnio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rechnio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rechnio_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers of the Rechnio account, optionally searched by company, person name or email. Returns customerNumber, company, contact and address fields. GET /api/v1/customers.

search.description: Search in company name, first/last name or email.

tools.name: rechnio_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Give a company name for a business customer, or a first and last name for a private person. Returns the created customer with its customerNumber. POST /api/v1/customers. If the call fails with a network or timeout error, the record may already exist: list the records first before you retry.

country.description: Country code, e.g. AT, DE, CH.

tools.name: rechnio_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first, optionally by status (draft, sent, paid, cancelled). Each invoice has invoiceNumber, totals, VAT, dates, customer and line items. GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: rechnio_create_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice as a DRAFT. The vendor assigns the next number from the given series. This tool never sends the invoice; the customer sends it in Rechnio. POST /api/v1/invoices. If the call fails with a network or timeout error, the record may already exist: list the records first before you retry.

series_id.description: Invoice series id (from Rechnio → Einstellungen → Serien).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. Stk., Std., Pauschal (default Stk.).

due_date.description: Due date yyyy-mm-dd (default: series payment term).

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 20, 13, 10, 0 (default: series value).

reverse_charge.description: Reverse charge: sets the VAT rate to 0.

sepa_direct_debit.description: SEPA direct debit notice instead of a transfer text.

notes.description: Free-text note printed on the invoice.

tools.name: rechnio_list_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions, optionally by booking date range, category or account. Each has amount, description, category, bookingDate and account. GET /api/v1/transactions.

tools.name: rechnio_list_receipts
tools.title: List receipts
tools.description: List uploaded receipts with their OCR results (date, amount, counterparty, description), optionally only assigned or unassigned ones. GET /api/v1/receipts.
